preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists representing a 2D structure.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == len(grid[0]) if grid else True
preconditions.description: The grid is square (N x N) if it is non-empty.
The grid dimension N is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in (0, 1) for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the grid contains either 0 (water) or 1 (land).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if (all(cell == 1 for row in grid for cell in row) or all(cell == 0 for row in grid for cell in row)) else max(min(abs(r - lr) + abs(c - lc) for lr, lc in land_cells) for r, c in water_cells)
postconditions.description: If the grid contains only land or only water, return -1. Otherwise, return the maximum of the minimum Manhattan distances from each water cell to any land cell.
